name: dsh-two-stage-promotion
author: stultuss
description: 二阶段晋升模式 agent preset for the dsh web GUI: a two-phase promotion preset — phase 1 exposes the builtin Minimal exact surface (one persistent bash tool since DSH 0.1.5-rc.1) with no runtime contexts or injected instructions (Minimal-aligned trajectory anchor); promotion is gated on the first minimal-like reasoning block with a fallback; the wire then switches to PTC Mode (a single run_code tool over the full registry) with the ordinary injections returning afterwards. The preset files are synced into ~/.dsh/.agent-presets on host startup. Targets the DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 preset surface (persona prefix section, single-tool Minimal, ptc presentation); the Session API is still read through feature detection.
